decision_basis: Direct F11R/JAM-A-LFA-1 alphaLbeta2 interaction and leukocyte adhesion/transendothelial migration support qualified-high exact adhesion/function evidence; activation state and endothelial cytokine context remain bounded.

Thrombin cleavage/activation of PAR2 with receptor-proximal and cellular outputs supports qualified-high conditional relay/function evidence; thrombomodulin, TF-FVIIa/cofactor, and cell-type requirements are retained.

Thrombin cleavage of PAR3 and PAR3-dependent enabling of PAR4 platelet signaling support qualified-high PAR3/PAR4 cofactor-complex relay/function evidence; species and non-autonomous PAR3 signaling boundaries remain explicit.
